Disconnect the N-C(O) bond of the carbamate.
This gives the amine `H2N-CH2-Pyridine` and the acylating agent.
For Boc protection, the acylating agent is Boc2O: `CC(C)(C)OC(=O)OC(=O)OC(C)(C)C`.
Sometimes, the reagent is just listed as the protecting group source.
